name: Taste Skill
hook: 112k stars on GitHub. A Claude Code skill that gives agents real art direction: it classifies your business, plans each screen, pairs fonts and palette, pulls real photos, and runs a headless Chrome check for layout and contrast before finishing. The result is polished pages instead of generic AI slop.

name: Archify
hook: 94.4k stars. An Apache-licensed agent skill that turns any idea, plan, or codebase into an interactive HTML diagram — Architecture, Sequence, ERD, Class, Timeline, and 6 more. The output is a self-contained shareable file that exports to PNG/WebP/PDF. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode.

name: RTK
hook: 85.8k stars. A single Rust binary that proxies shell command output and strips everything an LLM doesn't need — cutting token consumption 60–90% on common dev commands. Zero dependencies, installs in one brew command. Tops the claude-code GitHub topic on cost-reduction tagging.

name: OmniRoute
hook: 85.4k stars, MIT. A local AI gateway that exposes one endpoint and routes to 375 providers (150+ free tiers), 1,400+ models, with automatic fallback when quotas run out. Cuts inference costs by keeping coding agents on free-tier providers until they're exhausted.

name: Claude Code v2.1.319
hook: Shipped November 6. MCP server tool calls now move to the background automatically instead of blocking the terminal. New `permissions.denyInsteadOfPrompting` lets CI/subagent runs fail fast instead of hanging. `/claude-api latency-optimize` finds where your API code makes users wait and tests faster settings against your eval.

name: Agent Reach
hook: 110k stars. A Python CLI that gives AI agents read and search access to platforms they normally can't reach — Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, and more — with no API fees. Read-only by design; reuses existing browser logins only for the named site.

name: ARIS (Auto Research In Sleep)
hook: 18.8k stars. Markdown-only skills for autonomous ML research: an executor model (Claude Code) does the work while an independent reviewer (Codex MCP by default) cross-checks it, avoiding single-model blind spots. Covers idea discovery, experiment automation, paper writing, rebuttal drafting, and slide generation.

name: BrowserAct Skills
hook: 6.3k stars. A browser automation CLI built for AI agents — with layered anti-bot handling (fingerprint spoofing, proxy switching, CAPTCHA solving) and a human-takeover link when the agent gets stuck. Runs parallel isolated sessions and outputs compact indexed element commands instead of raw DOM.

name: career-ops
hook: 80.9k stars. An open-source AI job search agent that runs inside Claude Code and scores each listing 1–5 against your CV, checks whether it's still live, drafts a tailored ATS-friendly CV and cover letter, and tracks applications — without auto-submitting anything. All data stays local.

name: One Skill to Rule Them All
hook: 3.8k stars. A meta-skill that watches your Claude Code sessions and after each one proposes targeted edits to your existing skills based on what the agent got wrong or corrected mid-task — with approval required before any changes apply. Treats your skill library as living documentation.
